content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?ScienceKonek's PostScienceKonekApril 2 at 4:00 AM · Shared with Public#SciFeature 𝗝𝗨𝗦𝗧 𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗙𝗔𝗥 𝗪𝗜𝗟𝗟 𝗔𝗥𝗧𝗘𝗠𝗜𝗦 𝗜𝗜 𝗚𝗢?The Artemis II crew, aboard the Orion “Integrity” spacecraft, will be traveling around 400,000 kilometers away from Earth during their lunar flyby. That is equivalent to roughly 𝟰𝟭𝟬 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗱𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗹𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗗𝗮𝘃𝗮𝗼. The crew will be traveling 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝘂𝗽 𝘁𝗼 𝟯𝟵,𝟱𝟬𝟬 𝗸𝗺/𝗵 to reach the moon early next week.The average distance between the Moon and the Earth is around 384,400 km, and Artemis II will attempt to go far beyond what any humans have been before in deep space. #ArtemisII #NASA #MoonAll reactions:2571 comment33 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Marie Elaine C.
